title: Outshine Adventures

services.name: Van Rental and Builds
services.desc: We’re Sunshine and Michelle Loveless, queer nomads traveling the country in a Vandoit we’ve nicknamed Stardust. We hope to inspire folks to adventure differently and reconnect with the transformative power of nature by sharing our adventures and vanlife travel tips. Follow our adventures on instagram as we travel the country in Stardust! Catch us at events to see the van in person and get inspired for your next road trip. Learn about the vans you can rent through the Nomad Be Happy Rental platform, the Vandoit MOOV model we’re traveling in and how you can build your own transformative adventure van with Vandoit.
